newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says Oct pax yield up 3.6pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says Oct pax yield up 3.6pct.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG improved its average yield per passenger in October by 3.6 percent year-on-year, the airline's investor relations department said.
The improvement was due to price adjustments, a large share of first and business-class passengers in all regions apart from Germany and a weaker German mark, the latest monthly investor report said.
Group passenger traffic rose generally in October and showed strong growth in particular to Asia-Pacific with a 6.3 percent rise to 331,000 passengers, the report noted.
Passenger traffic within Europe, including Germany, recorded a 1.9 percent rise to 3.27 million passengers and Americas sales rose 5.8 percent to 367,000 passengers.
